data.one_liner: Compile-time sealed world data with country, currency, language, and phone pickers.
data.what_it_does: Provides compile-time constant, tree-shakable classes containing ISO world data (countries, currencies, languages, phone codes) and ready-to-use Material widgets and customizable pickers for them. It supports automatic localization via a locale delegate.
use_when: You need country, currency, language, or phone code pickers in your app.
You want compile-time constant, tree-shakable world data without external API calls.
avoid_when: You only need a simple color picker or date picker.
You do not need ISO country or currency data structures.
strengths: Tree-shakable and compile-time constant data structures.
Includes customizable pickers and theme extensions out of the box.
Built-in automatic translation delegate supporting many locales.
weaknesses: Focused exclusively on world data and related pickers, not a general-purpose form builder.
Adds static dataset overhead if only a tiny fraction of countries are needed (though tree-shakable).
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and optionally register the TypedLocaleDelegate in your MaterialApp for localization.
